## TINEA PEDIS (ATHLETE'S FOOT), TINEA CORPORIS, TINEA MANUUM, OR TINEA CRURIS
Dermatophyte fungal infections are common worldwide. Dermatophytes metabolize
and subsist upon keratin in the skin, hair, and nails. Most tinea infections can
often be cured with topical therapy alone. Systemic therapy is reserved for
severe or refractory infection, recurrent infection, or in immunocompromised
patients.
Treatment should continue for at least one week after clinical curing of
infection.
## Treatment
[Terbinafine 1% cream apply to affected area BID x 2-4 weeks [M]](psjzid-terbinafine-1-cream-top-bid)
## Alternative
[Clotrimazole 1% cream apply to affected area BID x 4 weeks [M]](psjzid-clotrimazole-1-cream-topical-bid)
## Systemic treatment
[Fluconazole 150 mg q week x 2-4 weeks [R,DI]](psjzid-fluconazole-150mg-po-qweek)
< OR >
[Terbinafine 250 mg PO QDAY x 2 weeks [R,H,DI,O]](psjzid-terbinafine-250mg-po-qday)
